document.url_source: URLForSummaryofBenefitsCoverage in the plan year 2026 Plan Attributes PUF, row 97176LA0340010-01
document.retrieval_note: A plain request to the address returned the PDF, HTTP 200 with no redirect. The host's robots.txt (https://www.lablue.com/robots.txt, read 2026-10-27) disallows only /myaccount/*.
document.read_with: pdftotext -layout and pdftotext -raw, both with -enc UTF-8, without which the dagger mark is lost. The SBC is printed pages 1 to 7 of 7, which are PDF pages 1 to 7; PDF page 8 is blank and pages 9 and 10 are the carrier's nondiscrimination and language notices. The -layout output interleaves the columns of the service chart on page 4, so its rows were read from the -raw output. The chart's columns are "Network Provider (You will pay the least)" and "Out-of-Network Provider (You will pay the most)"; page 2 says "All copayment and coinsurance costs shown in this chart are after your deductible has been met, if a deductible applies." and "†Deductible does not apply.", so a value printed without the dagger is checked as applies_to_deductible true and a value printed with it as false. The prescription drug rows (page 3) are not checked, as in the UHC Bronze Essential check: the medical MVP's services are medical.

checks.printed: Services Your Plan Generally Does NOT Cover: Hearing aids
checks.note: A contradiction between the CMS file and the SBC, not a reading. The Benefits and Cost Sharing PUF row Hearing Aids gives IsCovered "Covered", CoinsInnTier1 "50.00% Coinsurance after deductible", CoinsOutofNet "100.00%" and a limit (QuantLimitOnSvc "Yes", LimitQty "1.0", LimitUnit "Item(s) per 3 Years"), with the Explanation "1 hearing aid per ear every 3 years"; the SBC lists hearing aids among the services the plan generally does not cover. The Marketplace importer follows the file, so the document says covered (spec section 5.4).

checks.note: A contradiction on a link, not a cost share. The Network PUF gives the plan's network, LAN001, NetworkURL "https://lablue.com/ppo-medical-vision-dental", which the document holds; the SBC prints the carrier's home page. Addresses are compared with the scheme, a leading "www." and the case of the host ignored, so the printed address is written here in the document's form, and the 2 still differ in path. On 2026-10-27 both resolved: https://www.lablue.com answered HTTP 200 with no redirect, the carrier's home page, and the filed address answered HTTP 200 after 2 redirects at https://findcare.bcbsla.com/?network_id=11, the provider search.
